"Two roads diverged in a wood, and I—	
I took the one less traveled by,	
And that has made all the difference." from "The Road not Taken" by Robert Frost

Right now, I am chewing through The God Delusion.

I both read and buy a lot of books. Infact, most of my funny money goes on books, as I go through them fast. I have a reading speed of around 6 ppm for fiction and 3-4ppm for non-fiction.

$100 of books barely lasts a few days :(

I always avoid reading fiction. When there are non-fiction books which are as gripping as the fiction ones, why read the latter as you get knowledge plus pleasure reading the former.

Examples of the books I am talking about are: The Black Swan, Brief History of Time, God Delusion, Selfish Gene, Predictibly Irrational,  etc. etc.

stt: Ask HN: Mind bending books to read and never be the same as before?
x: The God Delusion by Dawkins perhaps. I was agnostic before, atheist after.

After being forced into evangelical Christianity at a young age, no 2 books were more eye-opening and life-changing for me than:

Letter To A Christian Nation - Sam Harris 
The God Delusion - Richard Dawkins

The moment you realize you've been lied to your whole life is horrific and liberating ... it's hard to describe. Took many years to "let go" but i don't think it would have been possible without these 2 books for me.
